name: The Earth Orbiting The Sun
overview: Scripture reveals that God is the sovereign Creator who established the heavens and the earth, suspending the earth upon nothing as a demonstration of His power and wisdom (Genesis 1:1; Job 26:7). The sun and moon obey His command, with the sun even standing still by divine intervention as recorded in Joshua 10:13, affirming God's control over celestial bodies. The stability of the world is assured by the Lord's majesty and strength, indicating that the earth's order, including its movement around the sun, is under His sovereign rule (Psalms 93:1; Job 9:7).
